༄༅/ /zhing skyong dbang po'i gtor chen la nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs rim gyi lhan thabs ma tshang ba med pa bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la tsa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhing skyong dbang po'i gtor chen la nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs rim gyi lhan thabs ma tshang ba med pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha s+ya sa da ya/ gsang chen dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /gsang sngags rigs sngags mthu stobs nus pa'i gter/ /gsang rgyud ston pa po dang dbyer med pa'i/ /gsang ba rigs kyi bdag po bla ma rgyal/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa 'phags mchog klu grub rje/ /rgyal bstan gsal mdzad grub dbang ba liṃ ta/ /rgyal ba kun bdag sangs rgyas ye shes te/ /de sogs 'phags yul lung 'di'i srol 'byed rgyal/ /mkhas dbang mkhas pa'i mchog gyur dar ma grags/ /grub dbang grub pa mchog brnyes kha'ub pa/ /zab don zab mo'i mchog 'dzin sa chen te/ /bod yul bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bsngags par 'os/ /dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus gzhon nu'i sku/ /sku gsung zhal ldan phyin drug phyag gis mdzes/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan can skyil krung bzhugs pa'i lha/ /lha mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje spyi bos mchod/ /rab 'bar me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /rab khros dpa' bos gar gyi srid gsum g.yo/ /rab 'jigs gdong pa bzhi ldan yum bzhir bcas/ /rab mang bstan bsrung gtso de phyag gi yul/ /de ltar mchod 'os rnams la gus bstod nas/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor chen la/ /nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs pa'i gnad 'ga' zhig /gong ma'i gsung las btus te bshad par 'tshal/ /zhes mchod brjod dam bca' sngon du btang nas 'dir dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i mdzad pa'i stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor chen bsam don lhun grub la nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs rim 'ga' zhig brjod na/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma gtong tshe dmigs pa ni snod thod pa'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho gyur pa las dkar phyogs lha srin rnams kyi gsol te sgrub pa po'i stong grogs mdzad pa bsam la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bigh+nan sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan po'i gang zhig 'byung po zhes sogs kyi bka' bsgos pas bka' las 'da' ba mi nus shing ci bcol gyi las sgrub par bsam/ gtor ma dor la sum+bha ni dang zhal gyi sngags thung brjod cing bgegs skrad pa'i tshe rang gi snying ka nas khro bo khro mo pho nya las mkhan drag gtum mi zad pa'i tshogs lag nas mtshon cha thogs pa dpag du med pa spros te/ de dag gi sku las me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas te nag phyogs kyi mi min sgrub la bar gcod byed pa'i tshogs thams cad phyi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad par bsam la/ gnas yo byin rlabs kyi tshe gnas khang 'don cha bzhin gsal btab/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos nyams rtog gong 'phel bzhin bsgom/ mdun skyed maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kyi tshe maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu de nyid gdan pad nyi bdud bzhi tsam las mi bskyed pas/ de'i steng du kyai rdor lha dgu 'don cha bzhin gsal btab/ gtso bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par mos shing / de'i steng rdo rje 'chang sogs nang mchod 'bul rim gyi bla brgyud rnams dang / bar gyi cha la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ mtha' bskor gyi dur khrod gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho rnams dang / de dag gi bka' nyan gsung bstod lha srin sde brgyad sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par dmigs la/ dri med yid du sogs zhabs bsil phul bas zhabs bkrus/ zhal bsil gyi zhal 'thor thung gi sku lus bkrus/ mchod yon phyag du bzhes/ me tog dbu/ bdug spos shangs/ mar me spyan/ dri chab thugs kar/ zhal zas ljags/ rol mo snyan/ gos bzung sku lus la phul bar bsam la/ phyi mchod kyis mchod/ bdud rtsi sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bsam la/ g.yon pas mtheb srin gyi g.yon bskor du chos 'byung 'bri tshul byas pas dbus nas blang /

thog mar bla brgyud la 'bul tshe smin mtshams kyi thad nas 'thor/ yi dam la kha thad/ chos skyong la snying thad/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzhi bdag rigs drug rnams la lte ba'i thad nas 'thor/ dmigs pa ni snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo thod pa mang po 'bul yul de dang de la bdud rtsi rim bzhin phul bas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par bsam/ yid 'byung gi mchod pa ni/ thugs ka nas gau rī la sogs pa lha mo brgyad sprul pa rnams kyi thod pa'i nang du byang sems/ rak+ta dri chu/ dri chen/ sha chen/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i byang sems bcud len gsum gyi rdzas cang te'u thogs pa rnams kyis mchod cing / g.yung mo yum dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ gtso bo yab yum la snyoms 'jug gi mchod pa phul/ lha mo brgyad sogs gzhan rnams la 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byas pas/ thugs rgyud bde chen gyi ye shes kyi tshims par bsam/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyi glu dbyangs snyan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bstod par bsam la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma dang / bstod pa nyi shu pas bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma dam rdzas lnga bdun bcu gcig la sogs pa byin gyis rlabs nas dmigs pa 'don cha bzhin gsal btab/ gtor mgron mdun bskyed dur khrod brgyad du phyogs skyong brgyad/ byang shar gyi dur khrod kyi nam mkha' chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la lha chen brgyad 'don cha bzhin gsal btab/ lho nub dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la/ chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma brgyad kyi lte bar gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang pad+mas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la klu chen brgyad 'don cha bzhin gsal btab/

gzhan dmigs rim rnams 'don cha nyid zhal gsal bas 'bri mi dgos shing / gtor ma 'bul tshe/ dam rdzas bdun yod na dang po dang lnga dang gsum yin na dbus ma yi dam la 'bul bas dmigs pa ni/ gtor mgron de dag gi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma'i sum gnyis bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du 'khol zhing / sum cha gtor ma'i ngo bor gnas pa la zug pas bcud thams cad gsal zhing mnyes par bsam/ de rjes phyi nang yid 'byung bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams kyi dmigs pa gong bzhin gsal btab/ lha chen brgyad po sogs 'phrin bcol gyi tshig brjod pas 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi steng 'og bar gsum gyi sems can 'dus pa'i ngo bo rnams kyi rang gi yid la re ba'i 'phrin las thogs med du 'grub par bsam/ bde mchog gtor ma bsngo ba'i tshe/ dam rdzas bdun lnga gsum sogs las med na kyai rdor la phul ba'i gtor ma de nyid lhar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs te/ dur khrod kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur pa dang gtso dkyil the ba'i dkyil 'khor cha dgu'i lha tshogs kyi sbu gu byung ste gsol bar bsam/ phyi mchod nang mchod kyi dmigs pa kyai rdor bzhin las 'on kyang chu gnyis 'bul/ bdag po'i ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i tshe/ rang la zas kha lag gi 'brel thogs dngos po thams cad snying khar bsdus/ de dag gi snying kha nas rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid sna bdun/ mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nyer mchod lnga/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin du bsgyur ba de dag ba spu'i bu ga re re nas kyang de 'dra bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te mchod par bsam pa ni man ngag gi gnad dam pa yin te/ gnas skabs su 'brel thog chud zos su mi 'gyur ba dang / mthar thug tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod do/ /yab yum gyi rkang brgyad 'di ni bstod pa'i mchod pa yin pas dmigs pa ni sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyi snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyi sgo nas bstod pas mnyes par bsam/

de rjes mgon chen gtor bsngo nas dam rdzas bdun yod tshe gtor ma gnyis pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin rlabs dran par bya/ gsum pa dang lnga yin tshe g.yas kyi gtor ma la dmigs gtor mgron bskyed pa 'don cha zhal gsal bas bri ma dgos/ gtor 'bul gyi dmigs pa'ang gtor bsngo'i gzhung na gsal/ de nas/ dngos gzhi mgon po gdong bzhi pa nyid la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ thog mar gtor zor gyi mtha' bskor du bsham pa'i phrag gi mchod yon la rdo rje rtse lnga'i nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / a mṛ ta bsangs la sogs gtor bzlog gzhung bzhin las dmigs pa ni de dag gi thams cad da lta nyid du gsad cing bcad ma thag pa ltar rlangs pa 'thor zhing khrag rgyun 'dzag pa long long 'khor ba'i rnam pa can dang / rkang gling rol lnga rnams 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba'i sgra lta bur bsam/ a sogs kyi sngags phyag rgya bcas pas byin gyis rlabs/ yang gtor zor rdo rje rtse lnga'i nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / a mṛ tas bsangs ba sogs gzhung bzhin las dmigs pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas gtor snod thod pa stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥzhes brjod pas gtor chen dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus kyi phung po ri bo ltar spung zhing khrag rgyun rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil ba rba klong 'khrug cing phyogs bcu nas long long 'khor ba lbu ba'i phreng ba chal chil g.yo ba/ ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsam/ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de dag thams cad zad mi shes shing dpag du med pa 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur te zhing skyong 'khor bcas kyi gsol ba tsam gyi thugs rgyud tshim zhing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mthu bskyed nus par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi thams cad kyi bcud mtha' dag gcig du bsdus pa'i ngo bor bsam la/

phyag dang bcas yi ge gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ de nas mdun gyi rten rdo gru gsum nas nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa la dmigs nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang zhes sogs gzhung bzhin las dmigs pa ni maṇ+ḍal de nyid dang tshom bu sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs spyan 'dren gyi tshe rang thun mtshams kyi he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas 'phags sde me 'bar gnas bzhi sogs zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su phog pas/ de dag na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po yab yum bzhi drag po'i tshogs dang bcas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran te rang dbang med pa nam mkha' la sprin thim pa'am/ sa gzhi rlung dmar 'tshub par sku 'jigs pa'i gar bsgyur/ gsung rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog thugs bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i ngang las rnam pa sdig can ma rung pa rnams la khros pa'i tshul gyi gtum drag khro bo'i nyams dang ldan pa'i 'ur 'ur 'thibs 'thibs byon pas srid gsum thams cad 'dar khril li g.yo ba bsam la/ mgon po nyid kyi sbyar spos sam med na tshil chen dang gu gul gyi dud pa sbyar/ mi rkang 'bud cing dam tshig rdo rje g.yab dar dang bcas pas g.yob/ phyag len ltar gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas/ lha mchog ma hā kā la sogs brjod/ mdun gyi gnas de nyid du mngon sum lta bur byon par bsam/ gzhan gzhung bzhin las 'on kyang spyan gyi sngags la/ oṃ ma hā kā la nas de wi sa pā ri wā ra e h+yi he sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed du bskyed pa'i tshom bu ltar gsal ba la gnyis su med par thim pas nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od dang ldan zhing / dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig la za ba'i nus pa can du bsam la/ pad+ma ka mā la ya satwaṃ gyi pad nyi mi ro dang bcas pa gdan phul bar bsam pa/

a sogs mchod 'bul gyi tshe/ khrag gi mchod yon/ zhal dbang lnga'i me tog dbu la sogs pa'i rgyan/ tshil chen gyi dud pa shangs/ zhun chen gyi sgron me spyan/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab thugs ka sha rus kyi zhal zas ljags/ ro'i bye brag rnams snyan la phul bar bsam la/ a sogs shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sogs dam bzhag gzhung bzhin las dmigs pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i phyag du dam tshig gi rdo rje thogs te/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag ste bka' bsgos bas bka' las 'da' ba mi nus shing 'dar khri li li gnas par bsam/ dam bzhag gi gang la gang mtshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa sogs/ thal mo rdeb pa'i tshe mgon po 'khor bcas kyi dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe zor gtor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag du gsal ba la mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gsal ba las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing 'bul sngags lan gsum gyis 'bul/ phyi nang gi mchod/ 'phrin bcol ba rnams gzhung bzhin no/ /de nas dur bdag gzhi bdag gtor ma yan gyi dmigs pa thams cad gtor bsngo'i gzhung bzhin gsal 'debs pa ma gtogs 'dir 'bri mi dgos/ bzlas pa'i tshe 'khon gtsugs sbyangs ba'i dmigs pa ni/ gtor mgron rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar rdo rje 'chang dang 'phags mchog klu sgrub nas bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa thams cad sprin phung 'khrig pa ltar bzhugs pa'i 'og du kyai rdor sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba'i steng hūm̐ yig dkar po re re gsal btab/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po zla 'od lta bu 'phros/

bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la phog de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun chil gyi babs/ bla ma rnams kyi sku gang / rang gi sgo gsum gyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad dag bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i brgyun babs/ yi dam chos skyong gi sku gang / thugs ma mnyes pa dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad gtsang sing gi sbyangs/ chos skyong sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag bar gcod nyes ltung dri ma thams cad bshang gci gnyis dang ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'thon lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i skya mer gyi gang ba la sems gtad de yig brgya bdun bzla/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas rang nyid de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam zhing gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i thugs ka nas de wa pi tsu'i sngags 'phreng spros/ chos skyong rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas rang gi ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin 'grub par bsam la de wa pi tsu nyer gcig bzla/ yang rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros pa'i rtse la dam rdzas mchod sprin bsam gyi mi khyab pa sprul te chos skyong rnams kyi sku la thim pas dam rdzas kyi sku'i gzi mdangs rgyas/ 'od zer gyi nang gi spang rtogs rgyas pas bdag la shin du dgyes shing 'phrin las gang bcol thams cad 'grub par mos la yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma/ brgya rtsa re bzlas/ yang rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer nag po tsha zhing rtsub pa me stag 'phro ba spros/ mdun gyi mgon po la phog pas mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas las mkhan pho nya mtshon cha thogs pa dpag du med pa spros/

'jig rten gyi khams gang / de dag na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad mtshon cha'i dum bur gtub/ tshig gi rgyun bcad/ sems kyi rten phral/ rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyal/ ro ma rnams mes bsreg rlung gi gtor te rjes med du btang ba bsam la/ shā sa na brgya rtsa gcig bzla/ de bzhin du dmigs pa rnams/ lha mo rnams dpal mgon zhal bzhi sogs chos srung so so la rim pa bzhin du gtad de ro ru dang / zhal gyi sngags thung brgya/ gṛ ha rā dza bdun/ las mkhan pho mo'i 'bod pa lnga bcu re/ dkar bdud phur srung rnams la bdun re bzla/ bshags pa bskang ba sogs kyi dmigs pa ni/ tshig don de dang de la blo gtad yin pas go bas bcad nas bsgom/ de nas rdor glu yan gyi cho ga rnams grub pas/ thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa bskal pa'i me lta bu spros/ rten rdo'i tshom bu gtso 'khor lngar gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas sku lus kyi nang thams cad mes gang shin du 'jigs skrag pa'i ngang tshul gyi 'dar shig shig gnas/ dam nyams dgra bgegs la rab du khros pas/ zhabs sa la brdab pas sa gzhi g.yo zhing spyan phyogs kun du hrig gzigs pas pho nya las mkhan rnams kyang rab du khros par gyur te rang rang gi sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyi tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab par spros te lag du 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha thog zhal nas rgyob sod 'choms shig la sogs pa'i sgra chen po sgrogs bzhin pas 'jig rten gyi khams gang / dgra bgegs thams cad mgo bcad/ don snying phyung / rgyu lto lug srog rtsa gcad/ klad pa gtor/ sha rus 'jed/ khog khrag dang snying khrag dron mo thod skyog snyim pas bcus nas hub kyis btung / don snying nang khrol thams cad chem chem zos/ skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam/ ma hā kā la sum brgya bzlas/

de nas skam thun rlon thun bsangs sbyangs/ bskyed chog sogs gong bzhin gsal btab/ thun mchog 'bar ba sogs brjod pas de dag thams cad dgra bgegs bsgrol ba'i nus ldan du bsam/ ho rdo rje nag po chen po sogs bka' bsgo/ 'phrin bcol gyi tshig brjod pas zhing skyong 'khor bcas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran te rang gi grogs mdzad cing dgra bgegs sgrol ba la shin du rngams par bsam/ dgug gzhug gi tshe thog mar mdun gyi ling snod de nyid khaṃ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i gshin rje'i khang sgrom nag po gru gsum pa rgya che zhing / gting ring pa'i nang rlung nag dang me dpung gis gang ba'i gseb nas nad kyi bu yug tshubs cing dug char 'babs pa/ phyi nang thams cad srog bdud las kyi shan pa gshin rje khros pa lta bus yongs su gang zhing lag mtshon cha thogs pas dgra bgegs la gtug cing rgyob sod 'jigs pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i dbus su ṇi ljang khu las dgra bo/ tri dkar po dang pri ser po las pho gdon mo gdon rnams lus rid cing skra 'dzings pa/ kha sogs bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing / yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa/ gdug cing nyams thag du skad 'don zhing 'dar ba spyi bo gtsugs su gnas mtha' bskor du kha rang gi pha ma la sogs pa nye 'brel thams cad kyang gdug cing nyams thag pa'i ngu skad di ri ri 'don pas bskor bar bsam/ rten rdo'i tshom bu mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la rdo rje 'chang sogs/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha tshogs gur gyi mgon po lcam dral sogs sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar gsal btab cing de dag gi mtha' bskor du snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kyi tshogs rlung ltar 'tshub cing glog ltar 'khyug pas gang bar bsam/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer smug nag tsha zhing rtsub par 'phros/

mgon po 'khor bcas la phog de ma thag shin du khro zhing 'khrug pa'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i pho nya las mkhan srin po dang srin mo khros pa lta bu drag cing rngams pa'i rlung gi shugs ldan gyi lag na lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrogs/ dril bu/ tho ba/ mdung / ral gri/ dgra satwa la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ dgra bgegs log 'dren rnams kyi snying kha nas lcags kyu'i bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ yan lag lcags gis bcings/ dril bu'i sgras myos par byas/ ral gri sogs mtshon cha thogs pa rnams kyi rgyab nas rgyob sod kyi sgra drag po sgrog cing rlung nag 'tshub ma dang bcas pa'i ded de kha rang gi gzugs brnyan de'i drung du slebs te/ gnyen bshes kyi ngu 'bod 'tsher ba'i shin du brtse bas bsam pas de nyid la 'jug 'dod drag po dung dung yod par bsam la/ rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ na mo rje btsun sogs dgug gzhug gzhung bzhin gyi mthar/ oṃ ma hā kā la nas si+iṅgha li de wi sarba sha trun/ sa hu paṃ sarba sha trun/ gh+ri ta kī li kī li ya sarba sha trun bigh+nin pa ta ya na ma sarba sha trun a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ phyag len ltar dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya bskor zhing / liṅga'i steng du babs pas pho nya rnams kyi rang gi mdun du bkug pas dgra bgegs de nyid liṅga la sib sib thim pas liṅga de dgra bgegs dngos su gyur pas bsam/ aṅgu sha sogs spyan 'dren gyi sngags rgyas pa brjod kyang 'gal ba cher med mod/ 'on kyang gzhung las dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas ma bshad pa'i de ltar brjod tshe dmigs pa ni/ pho nya rnams kyi liṅga zhags pa dang lcags sgrog gis bcings shing dril bu'i sgra dang tho bas brdung pas sems smugs shing 'byung bzhi'i khams nyams par byas/ rnam shes spor bcog ma byas pa la liṅga dang dgra bgegs kyi sems skad cig mi 'bral bar bsam/

lha dbye rgyas pa kha sbyor dbye ba bzhi sogs ni man ngag yongs rdzogs thob pa'i gang zag kho nas nyams su blang bya yin pas 'dir ma spros la spyir btang tsam la dmigs pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pa liṅga'i snying kar thim pas de ma thag kho la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu yod pa thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam pas liṅga'i gnas gsum las thon/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas rang nyid sngar bas kyang gzi brjid nus cher rgyas par bsam/ yang kho la 'jig rten pa'i lha srung skyob byed pa'i pho lha mo lha zhang lha lhan cig skyes pa'i lha'am mgo ba'i lha la sogs pa de dag thams cad rang gi thugs ka nas me dang mtshon cha la sogs pa dpag tu med par spros te skad cig la phyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad pa'i bsrung skyobs byed dbang med par bsam zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre la sogs pa srog gcod kyi bdud thams cad phung phung gnas par bsam zhing sngags thung gi siṅgha li/ de wa'i mthar sarba de wa rak+ṣaḥbi de sha ya hūm̐ ya hūm̐ ces btags pa brjod do/ /'di ni gzhung las ma bshad cing drag po'i las sbyor lha dbye gnad du che zhing / mgon po che chung gi man ngag phal cher las bshad pas 'dir bris pa yin zhing / de ltar na dgug gzhug rjes ma'i mthar rdo rje snying kar bzung zhing dril bu drag du dkrol la lha dbye'i sngags 'di dmigs pa dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod do/ /dpang gzugs kyi dmigs pa ni gong du bshad pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa rnams dang khyad par dgra bo de nyid la 'khor mdzad mi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu yin na de nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa dpang por gsol bar bsam zhing /

rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos dgra bgegs nyes byas rnams sgral bar bsam la/ dkon mchog gsum po dgongs su gsol bar bsam sogs zhal gyi sgor gyi dpang gzugs dang spyi 'gro'i dpang gzugs slob dpon nag po zhabs kyi mdzad pa rang res drug cu pa sogs la gnang ba'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥngs ni ma nyes ma thos sogs tshar gcig brjod pas bla ma yi dam chos srung dregs byed spyi dang khyad par dgra bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa de nyid dang zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa 'khor bcas dgra bo la shin du khros shing rang nyid bden par dgongs te dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i dgongs pa rtse gcig du mdzad par bsam/ de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs drag bskul gyi tshe rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po dug sdong lta bu bsam gyi mi khyab par spros/ mdun gyi zhing skyong gtso 'khor lnga'i thugs kar phog pas de rnams khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i sku las khro bo khro mo zhing skyong pho mo srin po srin mo gshin rje pho mo sha za ro langs la sogs pa lag na 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha thogs pa mthong ba tsam gyis dgra srog skad cig la gcod nus pa'i tshogs bung ba tshangs nas brdol ba ltar 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phros/ de dag thams cad sha rus la sbrang bu rub pa ltar 'brub khung gi phyogs mtshams thams cad du thib thib gnas pa dang / gong du bshad pa'i 'brub khung gi phyi nang du gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad srog bdud las kyi shan pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi kyang liṅga dgra bgegs su gsal ba'i lus la nad dang dug dang mtshon cha'i char pa phab/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i skabs thun 'phang pa thams cad mtshon cha me 'bar ba dang dug sdong me dpung 'bar bar bsam la/ sgo nas byung ba'i gsang sngags rnams brjod cing liṅga grab/ de bzhin du rlon thun dug nad kyi rang bzhin khrag mtsho 'khol mar bsam pa dgra bo'i lus la phog pa'i mod la dal yams rims nad drag po'i skad cig nyid la srog rtsa gcad nas sems dran med du brgyal/

sha rus kyi phung po myog myog btang bar bsam la/ rlon thun rwa nang nas drag po'i shing 'ug pa'i sgro'am ro skra'i pir gyi gtor ma 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags rnams brjod cing dmigs pa rtse gcig du bya/ de nas gri gug thogs la thog mar liṅga'i snying khar btab la dmigs pa ni/ liṅga'i snying kha nas rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge ṇi ljang khu 'od bral ba zhig gri gug gi so la 'khril te rang he ru kar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ rdo rjes lam nas rang 'od kyi yum gyi pad+mar babs pa la dgra'i rnam shes de nyid he ru ka rdor dril 'dzin pas rnam par gyur te/ skad cig la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs du mas 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char chen po 'bebs bzhin pas 'og min mkha' spyod rig pa bzhi par gnas par bsam/ phaṭa brjod cing mig gyen du yun ring du bltas la bsgral bya sgrol byed sgrol mkhan gsum dbyer mi phyed par chos nyid bde ba chen po'i ngang du ci gnas zhig mnyam par bzhag slar yang pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi phyag mtshan mtshon cha du mas dgra bo'i rnam smin gyi phung por btang bar bsam la/ gri gug gi liṅga'i rkang pa gnyis nas spyi bo'i bar gtub cing ngag du/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi ka tra ka ra la nas dzau dzin+ti da sha dik+ta ut+tar wa ri sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / ḍoṃ bi ni sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du tsan+ḍa li sarba sha trun༞ rak+kha si sarba sha trun༞ siṅgha li sarba sha trun༞ oṃ u tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa tha hūm̐ sarba sha trun༞ pa i sarba sha trun༞ sa ka ra la hi yi sarba sha trun༞ sa hu baṃ sarba sha trun༞ gh+ri ta ki li ki li ya sarba sha trun༞ bi bhi ṣa ṇa pa ta ya na mā sarba sha trun bigh+nan ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha trun mā ra ya de wi ha na ha na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ da ha da ha/

pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ la hi ba liṃ/ de wi sid+dhi sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing dum bur btub/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i tshe ling ro de nyid sha'i phung po rus pa'i ri rab khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes par mos pa de nyid mgon po 'khor bcas kyis gsol ba'i thugs brgyud tshims par bsam/ de nas gsol kha bya ba ni/ gtor chen gyi mdun du gtor stebs lnga tshar la ling snod dang sha chang la sogs pa phyag len bzhin blugs te/ hoḥdapal ldan mgon po nag po ma hā kā la zhes sogs gzhung bzhin brjod pa'i mthar drag rol mi rkang gi sgra'i sbugs la sngags thung la gtor sngags btags pa brjod/ de ltar lan lnga brjod/ de'i dmigs pa ni/ gtor zor sha khrag rus pa'i phung po zag med bdud rtsi rgya mtsho bsam la ling ro sha chang la sogs pa phul bas slar yang dpag du med pa 'phel ba de nyid la rten rdo'i tshom bu zhing skyong 'khor bcas gsal ba'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gsol bas thugs rgyud tshims shing sku nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od dang ldan par gyur te dgra bgegs bsgrol ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par bsam/ gzhung las ma bshad kyang phyag len skabs 'dir mngon spyod rol pa sogs ma mdzad pa'i de dag gi dmigs pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab/ de rjes tshogs rdzas byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas tshogs 'khor bzhin las dmigs pa ni/ tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal ba la yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gsol bas rgyud tshim zhing rang gi longs spyod pas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lhag gtor btang bas 'byung po tshims par bsam/ gtor 'bul gyi dmigs pa ni/ mthun gtor chos srung rnams kyi gsol bas lhag ma dug mtshon la sogs pa me dpung 'bar ba gyur pa de nyid pho nya rnams kyi dgra rdul du khyer gtan brlag tu btang bar bsam/

mjug chog gi phyi nang gi yid 'byung bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams kyi dmigs pa gong du bshad pa bzhin dang / yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / brtan bzhugs kyi tshe bla ma yi dam sogs kyi rten spyi dang khyad par rten rdo'i tshom bu zhing skyong gtso 'khor lnga bskyed pa de nyid drag las mthar ma phyin bar du brtan par bzhugs par bsam la/ me tog 'thor zhing su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod/ lha brgyad rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams thang sku sogs so so'i sku la thim bskyed cing gsal btab pa'i dam tshig pa rnams snying kar bsdu/ rang nyid he ru ka gsal ba'i skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lhag ma rnams gsal btab ste go bgo dge ba 'di yi dang / mtshungs med bla ma sogs kyi smon lam bkra shis kyi mtha' brten par bya zhing spyod lam thams cad thun mong ba'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i gur khang gi nang du he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par gsal btab bo/ /tshul de lta bu'i zhag bdun la sogs par sgrub pa'i dmigs pa thams cad gong bzhin las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par nub gnyis pa nas bzung gtor zor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin sha rus kyi phung por bsam pa de nyid dang / rten rdo'i tshom bu zhing skyong gtso 'khor lnga gsal ba de nyid gsal 'debs pa tsam mo/ /nub tha ma'i tshogs 'khor yan gong bzhin las/ de nas rang nyid zhwa nag gos nag la sogs pa gyon te lag du gri gug dang bhan+dha thogs/ phyag len ltar kye bos ma'i bskul gyi tshe dmigs pa ni/ zor gtor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zhing skyong 'khor bcas kyi gsol ba'i lhag ma de nyid dug gi sdong bu mtshon cha'i phung po me dpung gi rang bzhin du bsam/ rdo zor yum bzhi gshin rje la sogs pas dmag tshogs kyi bskor ba zhu ba las byung ba'i thog dang mtshon cha'i me cher 'bar ba bsam/ rlon thun dregs pa pho brgyud ngo bor bsam pa zhu ba las byung ba'i khrag nad yams nad rgya mtsho chen po rba rlabs chal chil g.yo bar bsam/

rang thun mtshams kyi he ru ka gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dal yams nad la sogs pa thams cad yi ge maṃ smug nag gi rang bzhin du gyur pa dpag du med pa bkug nas gtor chen dang / rdo zor rnams la char bab pa bzhin sib sib thim pas zor rdzas rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa sngar bas kyang lhag par 'phel zhing rgyas te ri rab chen po dang dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi yang skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlag nus pa'i bdag nyid can du bsam/ mdun bskyed kyi zhing skyong 'khor bcas kyi rab du khros shing bzhugs pa'i sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung du ma bcas te rang gi rgyab dpung la byon par bsam zhing / phyag len ltar chos skyong spyi'i drag bskul dang stobs 'phrog drag po'i drag bskul la sogs par bya/ de nas sde brgyad kyi thebs phyogs dang gtor ma 'phang sar slebs pa dang thog mar gser skyems 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du gnas bdag gzhi bdag la sogs pa smug pa 'khrigs pa ltar bskor nas 'khod pa rnams la/ gser skyems kyi mchod pa phul bas mnyes shing rang gi sdong grogs mdzad pa dang / 'byung po mthu bo che rnams kyang bdud rtsi des tshims nas ko long ma byed par rang gi grogs ra 'da' ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin nyan par mos/ zor lam dbye ba'i tshe rang he ru ka'i nga rgyal brtan pos phyogs mtshams steng 'og du 'khod pa'i 'byung po rnams la bka' bsgos pas rang gi phyogs su sku zur nas zor lam thams cad dgra bo'i yul du thal ba'i ded par bsam/ mngon spyod rol pa sogs kyi bskul gyi tshe/ dgra bo'i yul gnam lcags las grub pa'i khang sgrom gru gsum mun pa nag po'i gling du dug khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khol ba'i klong du dgra bo mi nor bcas shin du mi sdug pa'i gzugs can sdug bsngal gyi nyams thag pa'i smre sngags lhang lhang 'don par bsam/

dmigs ma yin pa spyi dgra lta bu la gtor ma 'phangs pa'i sa phyogs de nyid du 'brub khung khrag mtshon bcas pa'i nang du bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams mngon sum lta bur bsam/ bskul gyi mthar sngags dang bcas rwa zor 'phangs pas dmigs yod na yul phyogs dang spyi dgra yin na mdun gyi 'brub khung gi nang thams cad yams nad dug dang khrag nad 'dus pa'i ngo bo khrag mtsho 'khol ma/ 'od zer sna lnga'i rlangs pa phyogs bcur 'phro bas mer gyis gang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams rim nad dang yams nad kyi myos sbrang bu mes tshig pa ltar nag chem chem song bar bsam/ 'dir rwa zor gyi rtse ston phyogs brtag tshul ni gsang sngags rnying ma ltar na kha thebs lce thebs zhes pa'i tha snyad byed nas rwa'i rgang rang nyid la bstan na bzang bar bshad kyang / rang lugs gsar ma bar ma ltar na rwa rtse dgra phyogs su bstan na dgra bo de 'chi/ g.yas g.yon la bstan na dgra bo'i 'khor dang nor la gnod pas bzang / rang la rtse bstan na ngan pas skyar nas 'phangs/ de nas kyang rtse bstan na yi dam mgo mnan la 'phang / de nas kyang rtse bstan na yi dam gyi mgo mnan la 'phang / de nas kyang spang rtog mchog sogs bya ba bshad do/ /de nas yum bzhi'i rdo zor re re 'ur rdor bcug la khrag 'thung ma hā kā la sogs bskul dang bstun rim bzhin 'phangs pas/ rdo zor de dag thog dang rdo char du gyur te yul khams thams cad bcom/ yum chen bzhi so so nas bka' nyan gshin rje'i bdud 'chi bdag sha za'i tshogs kyi dmigs tshogs dang bcas dgra bo 'khor gtan rlag du btang bar bsam/ de nas gtor chen gyi thebs kyu 'phang zhing pho nya rnams bskul bas de dag gi la las dgra bo gshin rje'i khram la btab/ la las sho rdel dkar nag bkram/ la las nad rkyal phye la mtshon gru brkyang / la las ltas ngan gyi sprul pa bskyed de dgra yul thams cad mi 'dod pa'i ltas ngan sna tshogs kyis bkang zhing thal bar brlag par bsam la/

sngags dang bcas 'phang ngo / /de nas gtor chen thogs la bskul sogs byas pa'i mthar gong bsgral gyi skabs su bshad pa'i sngags rnams bzlas shing smod bskul las kyi rgyal po gnyan los mdzad pa de nyid dam rang gi blo dang bstun pa'i smod bskul gang shes brjod cing dmigs pa ni gong du bshad pa'i 'brub khung nang gi dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying dkyil na rnam shes kyi ngo bo 'od mar me ltar gsal zhing bya ma gsar gyi sgong nga tsam yod pa de la gtor chen srid gsum 'joms pa'i mthu ldan de nyid rgyab pas mar me la g.yab do rgyab pa'am me la chu blugs pa ltar nag thum gyis shi bar bsam la/ gtor chen kha phub du drag du brdab bsgral bya'i sems dang rang gi sems dbyer med du bsres te brjod bral gyi ngang du cung zad bzhag chos gos sam thu ba g.yas pa la sogs gsal pa la drag du brdab cing dmigs pa ni rang gi rgyab dpung du byon pas zhing skyong 'khor bcas khro zhing rngams pa'i sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung dang bcas dgra yul du ches pas dgra'i yul thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlag dgra bgegs 'khor bcas kyi sha khrag rus pa don snying thams cad chom chom gsol/ rnam shes rgyal ba'i zhing du gnas spar ba bsam zhing phyi mig ma blta bar thun mong gi srung 'khor gsal btab cing / rkang rjes rnams rdo rje rgya gram du lam mos la rak+ṣaḥdang tshe gzungs bzla zhing sgrub khang du log la rjes chog rnams gzhung bzhin bya/ 'on kyang sgrub gtor rnams steng du 'bul tshe mgon po 'khor bcas kyis dgra bo gtan rlag du btang ba'i ngo bo bcas gsol zhing / srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i tshe/ rang la dngos grub kyi tshul du gtor mgron rnams kyi me tog dang nor bu sogs pa'i char phab par bsam la/ rjes chog gzhung bzhin las rten rdo'i tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/

/de dag gi zhing skyong dbang po'i gtor chen la nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs pa'i lhan thabs bstan to/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ /lta ba'i bsrung ma mthu stobs drag shugs can/ /lo chen gnyen gyi bod yul spyan drangs pa'i/ /gangs ljongs rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ /tsa turmu kha'i zab mo'i chos bskor las/ /'di ni dmigs rim 'ga' zhig bris la legs/ /'on kyang zab gnad mtha' dag dam ldan gyi/ /slob bu dag las gzhan du min pa dang / /chos skyong mnyes pas 'dri ba mi nus shing / /'on kyang dad ldan slob bu 'ga' yod na/ /tshad ldan bla ma dam pa'i man ngag bzhin/ /kho bo'i ngag gi sgo la'ang stsal bar rigs/ /de ltar nag po chen po'i gtor chen la/ /nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs rim bstan pa'i dge /nag phyogs bdud dpung gtan nas brlag pa dang / /sa bstan dar zhing rgyas shing gnas par mdzod/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma rje/ /kun dga' bkra shis zab dgongs chos dbyings su/ /nye bar rdzogs shing rjes 'jug dpon slob rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /ring min sa bcu gsum pa dbang bsgyur shog/ //ces pa 'di yang shugla dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul lo'i zor 'dzin las thog pa bstan pa'i rdo rje nas gtor zor sgrub dus kyi dmigs pa'i lhan thabs zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ 'khon rigs ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gzhi thog pho brang gi yang steng g.yab ring nyi 'od 'khyil bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer dang / shab lca mo ba rgyal tshe ring gis mgyogs par bris pa dza yan+tu// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 kun dga' blo gros/ zhing skyong dbang po'i gtor chen la nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs rim gyi lhan thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
